chapters.scope: Full chapter, 6.1 (Classification) through 6.8 (Polyhalogen compounds). NCERT confirmed section run via grep this session: 6.1, 6.2 Nomenclature, 6.3 Nature of C-X bond, 6.4 Methods of preparation, 6.5 Physical properties, 6.6-6.7 Chemical reactions (incl. SN1/SN2, elimination), 6.8 Polyhalogen compounds (6.8.1 Dichloromethane, 6.8.2 Trichloromethane, 6.8.3 Triiodomethane, 6.8.4 Tetrachloromethane, 6.8.5 Freons).

ncert_read_procedure: 1. Call mcp__Google_Drive__read_file_content with the fileId from this map.
2. Full chapter text is ~60k chars and WILL exceed the tool's token cap -- the error response names a saved local file path. Use that path.

3. Extracted text has PDF artifacts: drop-cap runs ('5.15.15.1 Werner's Theory Theory Theory'), section numbers colliding with exercise/example numbers. Grep tolerantly -- match on distinctive surrounding words, not exact section-number strings.

4. NCERT is authoritative for: term spelling, definitions, IUPAC names, standard formulae, constants, section numbering. NOT authoritative for: teaching order, exam technique, question selection, or exact equations in the extracted text (same unreliable-equation-extraction problem as the physics project -- write canonical correct formulae yourself, do not trust a formula copied from the extracted text).
